title: Text: DET Sam Menzin ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: You’re not sorry you missed my call, Sam. I know you’re not
Get a beer out of the fridge and call me and let’s talk about baseball
I’m going out for a cig in a bit, I’ll try you again then. Think about it’
Been thinking about some baseball stuff, wanna see what you think. Won’t ask anything about your team, I promise. Few minutes of good ball chat, you know
Anthony I’m spending time with my family and am unavailable. Hope you are well
No I’m in New York quarantining with them
Ok, figured you were just dodging me
